pages.text: The first power source of CyberFarm. It burns $(l)any furnace fuel$() (coal, charcoal, wood, blaze rods, lava buckets...) and turns it into FE. It needs no multiblock, so it is the way to power your first machines.

$(li)Put fuel in its slot.$(br)$(li)It $(l)pushes power by itself$() into every adjacent block that accepts FE: CyberFarm machines, $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l), and machines and cables from other mods.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)While it burns, the vent on its chimney spins. It coasts to a stop when the fuel is gone.

$(li)$(l)Generation$(): 60 FE/t while burning$(br)$(li)$(l)Buffer$(): 50,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Output$(): up to 400 FE/t per side$(br)$(li)$(l)Burn time$(): half of a furnace's$(br)$(li)$(l)One coal$(): 48,000 FE (40 seconds)$(br)See $(l:generators/generators)Generators$(/l) for how long each fuel lasts.
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: $(li)When its buffer is full, the fire holds until there is room again. No fuel is wasted.$(br)$(li)A lava bucket leaves an empty bucket in the slot. Take it out to refuel.
